newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady at 619c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady at 619c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator was steady on 619 cents a kg clean on Wednesday in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19 micron indicator up to 1.5 percent dearer and 20/23m 0.5 percent dearer.
The 21m indicator was slightly cheaper, 22m was up to 1.0 percent dearer and 24/25/26m 1.5 percent cheaper.
In merino skirtings, 19/20m were 1.5 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27m was unchanged, 28m slightly cheaper and 29/30/31m 0.5 percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs and locks were slightly cheaper and crutchings generally unchanged, WI said.
WI said Japan, China and Taiwan were principal buyers with support from Western Europe.
Of the 24,298 bales offered, 6.8 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Melbourne and Fremantle with about 27,000 bales to be offered.
